choices.why: A 198 cm rectangular table in dark brown oak comfortably seats six to eight and brings the warm wood the user asked for, in harmony with the floor.
Classic chairs in grey linen with nailhead trim and dark legs give the 'clásico pero actual' look; three sets of two make the six chairs requested.
The large drum shade pendant gives warm, diffused light and an elegant timeless presence over the center of the table, with a dark structure that echoes the furniture.
A brown wood sideboard with cane doors adds warmth and texture, matches the tone of the table, and suits the long staircase wall.

answer.why: Dark brown wood on the table and sideboard harmonizes with the wood floor and the stair railing, while the grey upholstered chairs and the white fabric pendant soften the look and bring warm, classic-but-current light.
